description: RC-FIAP provides a graphical workflow for reinforced-concrete frame analysis with OpenSeesPy. Its documented functions include design, pushover analysis, incremental dynamic analysis and fragility calculations. The repository targets research and education and names code-based design assumptions. Those assumptions and the supplied frame models need checking before use in another regulatory or structural setting. Published by vfceball (repository owner). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Documentation is accessible through the linked paper or repository; executable access is limited to what that source states. Reuse licence: MIT. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-opensees. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
